name: Checkbox
hint: Tick the parent box, then untick one option: the tick turns into a dash.
description: Checkbox and CheckboxGroup on a real native checkbox: tick boxes for forms, terms agreement, multi-select filters and table row selection, with an indeterminate (mixed) state and a select-all parent. One mark, three shapes: the box fills from its centre on a spring, a single stroked path draws the tick a beat later with a small overshoot, and the same three points travel to the dash for the indeterminate state. Unchecking retracts the tick faster than it drew. The box squashes under the pointer.
intents: tick several boxes in a list
select all checkbox with indeterminate state
select rows in a table with checkboxes
usage: Use a Checkbox for a choice that applies when the form is saved: accept the terms, opt in to email, pick several filters, select rows in a table. For a setting that takes effect the moment it flips (dark mode, notifications on), use Switch instead; Switch's own usage points back here for form choices. For one choice out of a few, use Radio Group; for options that each need a card with an icon or price, use Choice Cards. Give a Checkbox `label` (and `description` if it needs one), then `checked` + `onChange(checked, event)` (controlled) or `defaultChecked` (it keeps its own state). Set `name` (and `value`, default "on") inside a <form>; `required` blocks the submit with the browser's own message and a form reset returns to `defaultChecked`. `indeterminate` shows the mixed dash and is announced as mixed; a click on it checks the box, and clearing `indeterminate` is the caller's job. `showRow={false}` with `aria-label` gives a bare box for a table's row selector. `readOnly` stays focusable and announced but does not change. `controlPlacement="end"` puts the box on the trailing edge so it lines up under a Switch in a settings list; `bordered` draws the row as a card as Switch does. For a labelled set use the second export, CheckboxGroup: `options`, `value` / `defaultValue` (arrays), `onChange(values, { value, checked, option }, event)`, `label` (the legend), and `selectAll` for a parent box that is checked, cleared or indeterminate from its children. `min` / `max` limit how many may be chosen. The ref goes to the native input.

keyboard.does: Moves to the next box; in a CheckboxGroup every enabled box is its own stop.
Checks or unchecks the focused box; a mixed box becomes checked.
Checks every enabled option, or clears them all when all are already checked.

screenReader: A native checkbox named by `label` (or `aria-label` with showRow={false}), with `description` read after it; it says checked, not checked or mixed (`indeterminate`) as it changes. With `error` it is marked invalid and the message is read as its description. CheckboxGroup is a group named by its `label` legend; the boxes under `selectAll` sit in a nested group named by that label.

dataProps.description: Visible label beside the box; it names the input. Empty gives a bare box (pass aria-label then).
Second line under the label, linked with aria-describedby.
Controlled state. Pass it with onChange and the box shows exactly this. Leave undefined to let it keep its own state.
Starting state when uncontrolled; also what a form reset returns to.
Shows the mixed dash and sets input.indeterminate (announced as mixed). A click on it checks the box; clear it yourself.
(checked: boolean, event) => void, on every toggle, and with event null on a form reset that changes the state.
Form field name. The input submits `value` under this name when checked, nothing when not.
Id of the native input (for an outside <label htmlFor>).
An error you already have, shown under the label in the danger colour and announced.
Widest the labelled row grows, in px. 0 lets it fill its container.
Goes to the native <input type="checkbox">: ref.current.focus(), ref.current.checked.
Any other attribute (name, value, form, aria-*, data-*) goes to the native <input>. className and style go to the root <label> and are merged with the component's own.

exports.description: A labelled set of checkboxes in a <fieldset>, the label rendered as its <legend>. Each box submits name=value. With `selectAll`, a parent box above the options is checked when every enabled option is, unchecked when none is and indeterminate otherwise; clicking it checks all, or clears all when everything is already checked (this is where the tick turns into the dash). `required` or `min` asks for at least that many with the browser's own validation message; at `max` the unchecked boxes go inert and a hint, linked by aria-describedby, says why. A form reset returns to defaultValue. The ref goes to the <fieldset>; its focus() moves to the first enabled box.

props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: node; description?: node; disabled?: boolean }>
props.description: The boxes, in order. A disabled option keeps its state and is left out of select-all.
Controlled list of checked values. Leave undefined to let the group keep its own.
Starting values when uncontrolled; also what a form reset returns to.

props.description: (values, { value, checked, option, all? }, event) => void. From the parent box value and option are null and all is true.

Terms.label: I agree to the terms of service

example:
<Checkbox
  label="Send me the release notes"
  description="One email when a new version ships."
  name="releaseNotes"
  checked={notes}
  onChange={setNotes}
/>

<CheckboxGroup
  label="Export"
  selectAll="All columns"
  name="columns"
  options={[
    { value: "date", label: "Date" },
    { value: "amount", label: "Amount" },
    { value: "payee", label: "Payee", description: "As written on the statement." },
  ]}
  value={columns}
  onChange={(values) => setColumns(values)}
/>
